BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The value comes from the local environment, such as file names or paths.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attacker must control a file name or path used by the command.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The attacker needs local access to create or rename files.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The command runs on the vulnerable host.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: An injected command can read any data on the host.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: An injected command can change data on the host.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: An injected command can disable the host.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: CONFIDENTIALITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Protecting application data and secrets is critical.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: INTEGRITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Integrity of data and code is critical.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: AVAILABILITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Availability matters but short disruptions are tolerable.
